```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

data_path <- "Y:/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/"

cohort <- readRDS(file.path(data_path, "cohort_outcomes.Rds"))
for_tir_calc <- readRDS(
  file.path(data_path, "for_tir_calc.Rds"))


```

# Create 30 day blocks between first and last TSH
```{r}
cohort <- cohort %>%
    ungroup %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate censoring date — minimum of 1 year after last TSH or last encounter
    censor_date = end_obs_date,
    
    # Time variable:
    # If event occurred — use time_to_first_cv
    # If censored — use days from last_tsh_lab to censor_date
    surv_time = case_when(
      cv_event == 1 ~ time_to_first_cv,
      cv_event == 0 ~ as.numeric(as.Date(censor_date) - as.Date(first_tsh_lab)),
      TRUE          ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

lab_blocks <- for_tir_calc %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  inner_join(cohort %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(episode_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
               select(episode_id, first_tsh_lab, surv_time),
             by = "episode_id") %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(tsh_date - first_tsh_lab)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tsh_value), tsh_value > 0, day >= 0, day <= surv_time) %>%
  mutate(block = floor(day / 30) + 1, log_tsh = log(tsh_value)) %>%
  group_by(episode_id, block) %>%                       # several labs in one block: average them
  summarise(tsh_value = mean(tsh_value), log_tsh = mean(log_tsh),
            n_labs_block = n(), surv_time = first(surv_time), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(episode_id, block)

segments <- lab_blocks %>%
  group_by(episode_id) %>%
  mutate(
    next_block = lead(block),
    next_log   = lead(log_tsh),
    slope      = (next_log - log_tsh) / (next_block - block),   # change in log TSH per block
    intercept  = log_tsh - slope * block,                       # so value = intercept + slope * block
    last_block = ceiling(surv_time / 30),
    # after the last lab: hold flat out to the end of follow-up (slope = 0)
    slope      = if_else(is.na(next_block), 0, slope),
    intercept  = if_else(is.na(next_block), log_tsh, intercept),
    n_fill     = if_else(is.na(next_block), last_block - block + 1, next_block - block)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_fill > 0)
```


# Slope and intercept between each lab and the NEXT lab, flag if in range
```{r}
blocks <- segments %>%
  uncount(n_fill, .id = "k") %>%                     # k = 1 is the lab block itself
  mutate(block_out = block + k - 1,
         log_tsh_imputed = intercept + slope * block_out,
         is_lab = (k == 1)) %>%
  transmute(episode_id, block = block_out, tsh_value = if_else(is_lab, tsh_value, NA_real_),
            n_labs_block = if_else(is_lab, n_labs_block, NA_integer_),
            log_tsh = if_else(is_lab, log_tsh, NA_real_),
            slope, intercept, log_tsh_imputed,
            blocks_since_lab = k - 1) %>%
  mutate(period = ceiling(block / 12))

lo_A <- log(0.4); hi_A <- log(4.5)
lo_B <- log(0.1); hi_B <- log(10)
lo_C <- log(0.4); hi_C <- log(6)


blocks <- blocks %>%
  mutate(TAR_A = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed > hi_A),
         TBR_A = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed < lo_A),
         TIR_A = 1L - TAR_A - TBR_A,
         TAR_B = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed > hi_B),
         TBR_B = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed < lo_B),
         TIR_B = 1L - TAR_B - TBR_B,
         TAR_C = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed > hi_C),
         TBR_C = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed < lo_C),
         TIR_C = 1L - TAR_C - TBR_C)

saveRDS(blocks, file.path(data_path, "tir_interpolated_blocks.Rds"))

```

# Early rise to next value alternative TIR calculation
```{r}
segments_v2 <- lab_blocks %>%
  group_by(episode_id) %>%
  mutate(
    next_block = lead(block),
    next_log   = lead(log_tsh),
    last_block = ceiling(surv_time / 30),
    n_fill     = if_else(is.na(next_block), last_block - block + 1, next_block - block)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_fill > 0)

blocks_v2 <- segments_v2 %>%
  uncount(n_fill, .id = "k") %>%                    # k = 1 is the lab block itself
  mutate(
    block_out = block + k - 1,
    is_lab    = (k == 1),
    fill_type_v2 = case_when(
      k == 1            ~ "lab",
      is.na(next_block) ~ "carried_forward",        # after the last lab
      k == 2            ~ "interpolated",           # the one block between
      TRUE              ~ "next_value"              # takes the next lab's value
    ),
    log_tsh_imputed_v2 = case_when(
      k == 1            ~ log_tsh,
      is.na(next_block) ~ log_tsh,
      k == 2            ~ (log_tsh + next_log) / 2,
      TRUE              ~ next_log
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(episode_id, block = block_out,
            tsh_value_v2    = if_else(is_lab, tsh_value, NA_real_),
            n_labs_block_v2 = if_else(is_lab, n_labs_block, NA_integer_),
            log_tsh_v2     = if_else(is_lab, log_tsh, NA_real_),
            log_tsh_imputed_v2, fill_type_v2,
            blocks_since_lab_v2 = k - 1) %>%
  mutate(period = ceiling(block / 12))

lo_A <- log(0.4); hi_A <- log(4.5)
lo_B <- log(0.1); hi_B <- log(10)
lo_C <- log(0.4); hi_C <- log(6)


blocks_v2 <- blocks_v2 %>%
  mutate(TAR_A_v2 = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed_v2 > hi_A),
         TBR_A_v2 = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed_v2 < lo_A),
         TIR_A_v2 = 1L - TAR_A_v2 - TBR_A_v2,
         TAR_B_v2 = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed_v2 > hi_B),
         TBR_B_v2 = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed_v2 < lo_B),
         TIR_B_v2 = 1L - TAR_B_v2 - TBR_B_v2,
         TAR_C_v2 = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed_v2 > hi_C),
         TBR_C_v2 = as.integer(log_tsh_imputed_v2 < lo_C),
         TIR_C_v2 = 1L - TAR_C_v2 - TBR_C_v2)

saveRDS(blocks_v2, file.path(data_path, "tir_interpolated_blocks_v2.Rds"))

```
